name: Bosch Home Comfort India Limited
summary: Bosch Home Comfort India Limited manufactures and distributes air conditioners, chillers, refrigerators, air purifiers, and variable refrigerant flow systems in India and internationally. It operates through Cooling Products for Comfort and Commercial Use; and Design and Development Services segments. The company offers inverter and non-inverter, fixed speed, split, non-inverter, hot and cold, packaged, window, and cassette air conditioners (AC); ducted and ductless air conditioners; centralized AC and room AC controllers; and water- and air-cooled screw chillers, and centrifugal chillers, as well as air quality solutions, and AC apps and controllers.
